tg-mit18901.title: James Munkres, MIT OCW 18.901 Introduction to Topology (Fall 2004)
tg-mit18901.notes: Open sets, continuity, compactness, connectedness, quotient spaces and topological invariants.

tg-readings.title: MIT OCW 18.901, Readings and course syllabus
tg-readings.notes: Reading sequence for topological spaces, continuity, metric topology, compactness and connectedness.

tg-hatcher.title: Allen Hatcher, Algebraic Topology, Chapter 1 (author-hosted edition)
tg-hatcher.notes: Homotopy of paths, fundamental groups, covering spaces and the winding number of a circle.

tg-mit-manifolds.title: Tomasz Mrowka, MIT OCW 18.965 Geometry of Manifolds, lecture notes (Fall 2004)
tg-mit-manifolds.notes: Smooth charts, tangent vectors, derivatives and manifolds.

tg-auroux.title: Denis Auroux and Kartik Venkatram, MIT OCW 18.966 Geometry of Manifolds (Spring 2007), Lecture 1
tg-auroux.notes: Differential forms, exterior derivative, pullback and de Rham cohomology.

tg-joyce-stokes.title: Dominic Joyce, University of Oxford, Stokes Theorem: Orientations and Integration (2019)
tg-joyce-stokes.notes: Orientation and Stokes theorem for compact manifolds with boundary.
